name: Shiroi Hako
source:
The protagonist and six girls awaken in an unfamiliar white space.
They have no memories other than their own names.

In this place that is different from reality, the seven search for their memories.
What are their backgrounds...?
And will they be able to return to the real world safely?

[Translated from DLsite]
